title: Goose x Bare Bones
description: This texture pack adds Geese in the Bare Bones style for Minecraft.
body:
﻿**This texture pack replaces Chickens and turns them into Geese!﻿**

﻿**-Changes Chicken items to Goose items﻿**

﻿**-New Spawn Egg texture﻿**

﻿**-New Sounds for the Goose﻿**

﻿**-Custom Baby Gosling Model﻿**

﻿**This pack REQUIRES EMF, ETF + ESF﻿**

﻿**﻿OR OPTIFINE﻿**
